description: Stripe is a payments platform with a REST API for payments, billing, Connect and more.
auth_notes: Secret and restricted API keys (sk_test_, rk_live_, sk_live_) authenticate requests; the key determines live mode or sandbox.
gate_detail: Developers view and manage API keys in the Stripe Dashboard after creating an account. Test mode secret keys give sandbox access; live mode uses restricted or secret keys. Free signup cost not explicitly stated.
api_scope: REST API at api.stripe.com with form-encoded requests and JSON responses covering core resources, billing, Connect, Issuing, Terminal, Tax, Identity and more; official client libraries.
mcp_notes: Stripe docs publish an MCP server at mcp.stripe.com with OAuth or agent API key authentication.
blocker_detail: No approval or payment gate stated; restricted keys can be configured with specific permissions.

evidence.quote: The Stripe API uses API keys to authenticate requests.
You can use the Stripe API in sandboxes without affecting your live data or interacting with banking networks.
The Stripe API is organized around REST .
Test mode secret keys start with sk _ test _ and have unrestricted access to their sandboxes.
OAuth : Use OAuth when a client accesses Stripe on behalf of your Stripe user account.

uncertainties: Sources do not explicitly say account signup is free or instant.
Webhooks inferred from API reference navigation listing Webhooks and Event Destinations.
Some Connect or other products may need extra enablement not covered by sources.
